retrieved_entries.issue_text: Agent failed to go to dresser 1.
retrieved_entries.learning_text: The agent successfully navigated to dresser 1 in a later trial.

retrieved_entries.issue_text: Failed to open drawer 2, the action had no effect.
retrieved_entries.learning_text: If a container cannot be opened, continue searching for the target object in other locations.

retrieved_entries.issue_text: Attempted to acquire an object from a closed cabinet.
retrieved_entries.learning_text: Open the cabinet before attempting to take items from it.

retrieved_entries.issue_text: Agent failed to take vase 1 without specifying its location.
retrieved_entries.learning_text: Always specify the object's location when attempting to take it.

retrieved_entries.issue_text: Agent tried to put object in a location without being at that location.
retrieved_entries.learning_text: Go to the target location before attempting to place an object there.

retrieved_entries.issue_text: Used 'put' verb instead of 'move' to place an object.
retrieved_entries.learning_text: Use the 'move' verb to place objects into containers or locations.
